thumbnail.purpose: route, trajectory, destination, and non-pose readability

native.purpose: takeoff-foot ownership, anatomy, cloth direction, and appearance observations

vo_wuxia_rooftop_route.evidence: At 512 px, old tiled roof planes on both foreground sides frame a deep alley gap and read as one height-changing route.

vo_wuxia_rooftop_takeoff.evidence: At 1536x1024, the trailing lower-left boot is immediately above the left eave tip, with a localized water splash marking that specific push-off support.

vo_wuxia_rooftop_trajectory.evidence: At both scales, the complete adult figure from head through both boots occupies the gap; hair and loose robe panels trail left while travel reads toward the right roof.

vo_wuxia_rooftop_destination.evidence: At both scales, a broad separate tiled roof on the right sits ahead of the leading boot and offers an unobstructed plausible landing surface.

vo_wuxia_rooftop_not_flight_or_pose.evidence: The left-eave splash, intermediate full body, coherent leftward cloth lag, alley gap, and forward right roof jointly establish a human roof-to-roof leap rather than a static pose or unsupported flight.

supplemental_appearance_reference_observ.scope: Visible adult appearance continuity only; no biometric identity, ethnicity, personality, attractiveness, or same-person inference.
supplemental_appearance_reference_observ.hair: Long near-black wavy hair and a near-center part remain visibly legible in the generated scene.
supplemental_appearance_reference_observ.face_shape: A softly oval facial outline remains readable at native scale despite the action framing.
supplemental_appearance_reference_observ.eyes_and_brows: Dark eyes and straight brows are visible, but exact eye color and fine spacing are not reliably judgeable at this subject scale.
supplemental_appearance_reference_observ.lips: Natural lip shape is visible; exact closed-lip continuity is ambiguous because the action face is small and the mouth may be slightly parted.
supplemental_appearance_reference_observ.identity_boundary: These are observable appearance cues only and do not establish that the generated person is the same person as Image 1.

user_judgment.evidence: No requesting-user preference or acceptance judgment has been received.
